summary: Iteration 90 — Validated all 5 newly-wired live features end-to-end for Obserra Agentic v1. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed covering /api/agents/runtime/webhook GET/PUT/clear/invalid, /api/agents/runtime/enforce-bulk (suspend + invalid action), /api/actions/run (advisor agent_suspend/agent_resume), /api/ai-systems/discover, and single-agent /enforce regression.
